title: A counterexample to Kourovka Notebook Problem 16.45
strongest_supported_claim: For the explicit natural column-vector action of H=<A,B> in SL_2(F_29), G=F_29^2 semidirect H has order 100920 and b_f(G)=b(G)=3<4=mu_prime(G), with b maximizing inclusion-minimal base size over all faithful or nonfaithful permutation representations and mu_prime permitting nongenerating independent subsets.
exact_checked_claims: All-actions subgroup formulation requires normal total intersection; faithful formulation requires trivial intersection. Meet-irredundance without normality equals maximum independent subset size.
The restriction lemma applies to arbitrary subgroup families and to nongenerating independent subsets.
Concrete complement has 120 elements, is isomorphic to SL_2(5), has A_5 quotient by its unique involution, mu_prime=b=3 and faithful base invariant 2.
Thirty line stabilizers are cyclic of order four, with faithful scalar action and no nonidentity fixed vectors; prime-field and gcd restrictions are essential.
Every subgroup missing V has faithful base invariant at most two. All 1770 subgroups meeting V in a line, including all affine lifts, satisfy the verified scalar classification.
Irreducibility and faithfulness imply every nontrivial normal subgroup of G contains V; hence all nonfaithful actions factor through H.
Universal faithful/nonfaithful base upper bound three and unrestricted independence upper bound four follow structurally, without enumerating the full G subgroup lattice.
Printed independent generating four-set, omission orders and nonnormal order-two bottom; printed faithful minimal triple and degree5220; core replacement destroys irredundance.
